Subject: Discovery recap + pricing deck for Nimbus Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we’re aligned:

- Goal: Reduce per-transaction inference cost and keep 95th-percentile latency under 200ms for user-facing routing.
- Primary workload: short multi-turn responses (6–12 tokens), batch embedding pipeline for analytics.
- Success metrics: cost < $X/transaction, latency SLOs per above, dedicated capacity for peak windows.

Attached is the pricing deck + initial estimate ("Nimbus_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf"). The deck includes: pricing by capacity tier, suggested Dedicated config, recommended quantization profile, and a proposed rollout timeline.

Suggested next steps:
1) I can walk through the deck with your engineering lead — 30 minutes.
2) If it looks good, we’ll put together an SOW and draft terms.

Would Thursday 11/12 at 10:00am PT or Friday 11/13 at 2:00pm PT work for a walkthrough?

Thanks — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Ben Carter
